title: Share at Which a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Restocking Fee Is Taken, by the Reason and the Inspection
content:
The fee so fixed is then taken at the share the reason and the inspection allow. Where the reason recorded is that the item arrived damaged in transit, no fee is taken at all, because the damage happened in the carrier's hands and not the customer's. Where the reason recorded is that the item did not perform as the customer expected and an inspection recorded that it came back opened with everything in the box, the fee is taken at half. In any other case the fee is taken in full.

## The quantity the share is taken on, and the quantity it gives

The percentage fee of a Northbeam Returns and Restocking return is the percentage charged taken on the price paid for the units coming back, and that percentage fee is then taken at the share the reason and the inspection allow. What the share gives is the percentage fee at the share the reason and the inspection allow. Where the schedule charges a flat activated device fee rather than a percentage fee, the share is taken on that flat fee.

| The reason recorded on the return | The inspections standing on the return | The percentage fee is taken at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| the item arrived damaged in transit | whatever they record | nothing at all |
| the item did not perform as the customer expected | at least one inspection recorded that it came back opened with everything in the box | half |
| the item did not perform as the customer expected | no inspection recorded that it came back opened with everything in the box | the whole of it |
| any other reason | whatever they record | the whole of it |

The second condition is compound: the reason recorded and an inspection on the return recording that the item came back opened with everything in the box are both required, and the reason alone leaves the fee taken in full.

## Points of judgement

**Why the transit case takes nothing.** The damage happened in the carrier's hands and not the customer's.

**Which inspections count for the half share.** Those recorded on that return whose grade is that the item came back opened with everything in the box; more than one such inspection standing on the return makes no difference to the share, which is half either way.

## Cases on hypothetical inputs

*A percentage fee of 40.00 USD, the reason recorded being that the item arrived damaged in transit.* No fee is taken at all, so the share gives nothing.

*A percentage fee of 40.00 USD, the reason recorded being that the item did not perform as the customer expected, with one inspection on the return recording that it came back opened with everything in the box.* The share gives half of 40.00 USD, that is 20.00 USD.

*A percentage fee of 40.00 USD, the same reason, with the only inspection on the return recording that something was missing from the box.* The share gives the whole 40.00 USD.

*A percentage fee of 40.00 USD, the reason recorded being that the item was the wrong size for the cabinet.* The share gives the whole 40.00 USD.
